target.basis: Current PR #236 head, used read-only as the strongest available native baseline; it is not merged by this experiment.
target.observed_gap: Four of ten strong finite physical probes fail the existing identified-source-projection criterion after stable arithmetic. G05/G11/G20/G21 at positive 0.1 m have relative errors .00574/.00646/.00514/.00862, against the existing <=1e-3 criterion. The complete strong scalar itself is already recovered; that is not the gap.

question: Can an autonomously selected external code mechanism improve an existing finite-inverse numerical invariant in Satellite's actual code, beyond the strongest reasonable direct local correction?
demand_origin: Experimenter formulation of the user's Missing Link test request, grounded in a documented current native failure. It is not a public GitHub issue or a statement from a blocked development agent.

fixed_acceptance.full_controls: All original 30 probes: ten strong finite cases and twenty weak +/- probes, preserving all unresolved full functionals and positive/negative outcomes. Retain unchanged 22-candidate/440-window/63-arc provenance denominators; do not claim new execution of all original RF folds.
fixed_acceptance.target_metric: Identified source projection, defined by the original stable-clock design, source-coordinate order and fixed 1e-10 relative spectral cut. Use the original <=1e-3 relative recovery criterion. Full strong scalar success is already baseline behavior.
fixed_acceptance.independence: The estimator must not receive the injected source vector, mode/sign/amplitude labels, expected projection, CODE state, target products or G12 state. These are evaluation only. No fitting restricted to the known injected direction.
preserve: same input products, weights, projector, coordinate units and physical forward model
10 degree mask and original physical-domain failures
all original historical artifacts and source bytes
fixed_acceptance.comparator: Unchanged stable-clock linear inverse, plus the strongest direct SciPy/local alternative implementable on the same allowed inputs. Its design and results must be recorded before inspecting any selected external implementation; a source packet alone is not gain.
fixed_acceptance.gain: At least one formerly failing native projection meets the original criterion with no formerly passing strong case lost and no full weak/null functional relabelled as recovered. Also report errors and runtime on every control, new dependencies/code size, all failed attempts and absolute error changes.
fixed_acceptance.stop: One model-selected source; no manual donor substitution, rescue query, retry, threshold or weight search. If the direct correction already meets the entire need, report direct sufficiency and do not manufacture a reason for source assistance.

discovery.path: Existing Provider.interpret_request -> plan_discovery -> PublicGitHub.search_repositories -> select_source -> fetch_repository/extract_structure -> interpret_capabilities -> evaluate -> export_handoff, using the existing Service/Budget/Store/account lease primitives.
discovery.intake_limit: The ordinary discover_from_request entry point currently accepts public GitHub issues only; the only current open Satellite issue is an infrastructure/parser extraction. Do not fabricate an issue, relabel PR #236 as an issue, post a request without authorization, or build a new intake/runner. Reuse the existing experiment-local invocation for the explicitly labelled local demand. This tests discovery and native transfer, not unchanged IDE/Service intake end to end.
discovery.model_choices: The model chooses operations, search phrases and the source, and may use_direct/defer/none. No donor, algorithm or alternative implementation is supplied by the experimenter. Cross-domain and cross-language mechanisms are admissible; eventual native execution must meet Satellite's supported environment.
discovery.target_context: Operator-selected, pinned excerpts around the failing recovery function, its projector and its physical forward operator, with explicit original line ranges, truncation and coverage limits. This is not autonomous target-file selection.
discovery.no_paid_dispatch_until: Distinct user budget approval and preparation review/CI green.

native_execution.path: After a defensible source-code packet, one bounded adaptation in an isolated target checkout, tested in Satellite's native modules/tests against the direct comparator. No new framework, transport, solver runner or generalized infrastructure.
native_execution.limit: Exposed-data development, not new measurement acquisition or prospective physical confirmation. Finite injected controls use the actual admitted-data physical operator but remain controlled injections, not proof of recovering real unknown source errors.
native_execution.code_policy: Any actual code changes require native Windows/Linux CI and regressions before integration. No historic refits or byte rewrites.

budget.authorization: not granted; prior 0.10 USD applied only to the finished #129 cohort

caveat: The producer's controls and this observer are already exposed. A successful result would demonstrate a bounded technical mechanism transfer chosen by the model; it would not establish universal discovery, physical source identifiability, causal rescue of a blind agent or S2 closure.
